question:
Which of the following pairs of letters will NOT be on the opposite faces when the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1cad2fe3bed53d8306c2bc8cc6ca759bda6395ac352538cc9d1634d6c477a04.png]
solution:
As per the given data:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05bf2b607f68a928c24629d45aa09d9852b7c0aa6af815fed9fa76a83186aaae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4aaca4d87032298274ae737b2e34eb906fa53d86018cb14578036fda34ec4dc7.png] 

Check all the options:

**(1) K and R → Not opposite faces.**

(2) T and W → Opposite faces.

(3) K and Y → Opposite faces.

(4) R and Q → Opposite faces.

Here, **'K and R' **are not opposite faces.

Hence, the correct answer is **"K and R".**
